cast.name: Mitsu Hanakaze
cast.role: Lead; a 20-year-old confectionery-college graduate running her grandfather’s 90-year-old wagashi shop.
cast.persona: Hot-tempered, industrious, and fiercely proud of traditional sweets, Mitsu wants to prove she can save Hanakaze Sweets without pity or compromise. Her emotions arrive first on her large expressive face, but every comic flare-up conceals genuine craft discipline and fear of failing her family.
cast.backstory: Mitsu grew up behind the Hanakaze Sweets counter and returned after confectionery college to run the shop while her grandfather recovers upstairs. She knows modern techniques but feels responsible for preserving the recipes, tools, and neighborhood trust handed down through four generations.
cast.visual_description: A 20-year-old Japanese woman with a big expressive face, short dark-brown bob tied back under a white tenugui headband, cream T-shirt, indigo apron, loose work trousers, and canvas shoes.

visual_brief.reference_lighting: Morning sun passes through the covered arcade’s overhead skylight panels, falling diagonally across the wooden counter and glass wagashi case; softer daylight enters through the open shopfront and catches flour dust in the air.
visual_brief.reference_background: A narrow morning view inside Hanakaze Sweets: faded wooden posts, a cream noren, shallow shelves, a glass case filled with pastel wagashi, a hanging wooden 営業中 sign, and the covered arcade visible beyond the open doorway; half-closed metal shutters recede into soft blur.

voice_brief.seedance_vocal_signature: Bright young Japanese alto with quick breath, explosive comic energy, and a rough clenched edge when pride is wounded.

cast.name: Ren Kurosawa
cast.role: Mitsu’s 21-year-old rival, a Paris-trained patissier running the new shop directly across the arcade.
cast.persona: Calm, precise, and maddeningly courteous, Ren wants his new patisserie to become the arcade’s destination shop because success will validate the exacting craft he trained for abroad. He respects Mitsu’s skill more than his composed manner admits and competes through immaculate work rather than open taunts.
cast.backstory: Ren returned from pastry training in Paris to open a compact French patisserie opposite Hanakaze Sweets. His polished launch attracts an immediate queue, placing him in direct competition with Mitsu even as his interest in local ingredients draws him toward her traditional methods.
cast.visual_description: A poised 21-year-old Japanese man with a narrow composed face, neat black hair, a matte white double-breasted chef jacket, charcoal trousers, a cream apron, and practical dark shoes.

visual_brief.reference_background: A compact French patisserie across the covered arcade, with warm-white plaster, narrow muted-gold trim, a pale stone-look counter, pastry boxes stacked on open shelves, and a long customer queue extending past neighboring half-closed shutters in the morning.

voice_brief.seedance_vocal_signature: Smooth young Japanese tenor with measured pacing, low breath noise, restrained warmth, and an unhurried professional cadence.
